notes.title: Inspector Waffles Early Days Release Date: November 15!
notes.notes:
The wait is over. Three years later, Waffles is finally back in a new retro adventure.🐱🕵️

Inspector Waffles Early Days will be released on November 15th on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614580/Inspector_Waffles_Early_Days/

Thanks for your support through the years, Waffles has been part of my life for the last seven years, and I'm super happy to finally share this new story. I hope you'll like it too :)

Take care ! 

Yann

notes.title: 1.0.3.1: Quick update for localization mod
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Have a good day,

- Yann

notes.title: 1.0.3: Workshop localization update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Long time no see, but it doesn't mean I was drinking a pina colada with Waffles (I wasn't). 

I'm happy to share this new major update with 3 main new features:

 Workshop localization
 16:10 resolutions compatibility
 Steam cloud saves

I have to be honest with you, this is the probably the last big update for Inspector Waffles and from now I'm going to focus mostly on my next games. 

Workshop localization

Some weeks ago, I found out that some non official localizations were available on Internet: it was a good surprise to see some players who were interested to make their own translations of my game. I helped them by creating a easier framework to include it in game. Fortunately, Steam lets devs to implement Steam workshop for community content.

Anyway, with this new feature, you'll be able to make the game in any language you want. If you are interested, I made an article which describes everything you need to know: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/18446744073709551615/5135803832916502175/?appid=1055850

Big special thanks to Vinczei who helped a lot to test it. He also did an hungary translation, which is super nice. You can already download it as a workshop item.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/f4e593d83d88ac28beab85d774ec8b8f3297d167.png

16:10 resolutions compatibility

Finally you can play Inspector Waffles in 16:10 resolutions, all bugs related to these screen resolutions are now fixed.

Steam cloud saves

Your save files are now stored in Steam cloud, you can now play through the game on different computers.


Thanks again for your feedbacks and support, and hope to share some news soon :)

-Yann

notes.title: 1.0.2.7 : Meow mew meow update
notes.notes:
Major updates: 

* Mew and woof languages added! Game is now entirely playable by cats and dogs.

Minor updates:

* In the final scene, you can't trigger dialogs involving Spotty anymore
* Missing item description (cinnamon...) fixed
* In Millie's house, the combining dialogs with the library is fixed


Have a good day everyone :)

notes.title: Devlog #01: Welcome to the first update!
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives!

Since the Summer Festival's demo, I've made lots of progress on Inspector Waffles wanted to share and update with all of you!


 New dialogue box!
I wanted to add more life to the dialogue box, adding special effects to better capture emotions like sarcasm, fear, surprise, etc. Below is a sneak-peek example; if you have any good suggestions, please share in the comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/d132e2affc881a9d6ddc5d2e03e402bef8e78213.gif

 Spotty and his scent-sniffing snout!
He's not present in the demo, so allow this to be my formal introduction of Spotty the Sniffer Dog; he'll have a very important role in the game. Inspector Waffles isn't sure about having a new sidekick though, not since what happened last time... but could Spotty change his mind? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/0aeb4afee766da65cd25399cc63ef546984939a3.gif

 Lots of new locations!
The game currently contains more than 40 unique locations/rooms. I wanted to share a couple screenshots (without any spoilers!) of some of these new locales where you'll be doing your sleuthing:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/157eec36596037c47bd079a294891d5310e5dc62.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/0fbb8ae337d65ee862597e323a29f610e133047d.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/d042c97f1ba4dfd14e7af2362186e93e928f3804.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/99dbf44bcdb949711e8b25a1b7d08e731953861d.gif



That's all for this first update. It's not a lengthy one, but I wanted to make this first post just to let you all know some of the things that have been happening lately.

There is lots more news to share in the future, including some community events, so I'd really love for you to join our growing Discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786718/819776f85adfab0ccacdc17b5619b1285ae915fc.png


Let's stay connected!
